Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns.
For standard returns of pristine items, customers are responsible for return shipping, and exchanges or non-damaged returns may be subject to a 10% restocking fee. In contrast, for approved damaged or defective items, you will not be charged a restocking fee, and minor damage (such as approved box dings) may qualify for a 35% account credit without needing to ship the item back.

Will I get a replacement or a refund?
Whether you receive a replacement or a refund depends on the extent of the damage and stock availability.
For approved damaged items, damage exceeding minor dings will be replaced or credited to your account (discretion is left to Capstone Games based on stock quantity allocation). For minor damage, an account credit of 35% may be issued without requiring you to return the item.
